name: iBuildNew

sources.title: Register route — renders marketing page for Australian home builders/developers/land estates; 'Book a demo' leads to contact form

requirements: Extremely narrow eligibility: Australian home builders, land estates, and knock-down-rebuild specialists only — not a software directory
No self-serve listing — 'Book a demo' routes to /help-pages/contact (a sales conversation)
Positioned as an 'accountable marketing (and sales) partner' — commercial lead-gen relationship, priced per marketing package
preparation: Proof you're an Australian builder/developer/estate with designs or packages to list
Homes/design/estate assets (plans, imagery, pricing) for the listing
workflow: Request listing/onboarding via the contact form or phone
Negotiate the marketing package; they publish listings for buyers to compare and enquire
watchFor: The cataloged 'Directory / Referral — free' framing is misleading: this is a niche AU property marketplace with sales-led onboarding
A SaaS/AI product cannot be listed here — only physical home builders and land estates
No published pricing; testimonials describe paid marketing ROI
They also upsell 'Conversion Assist' lead-response tooling
countsAsLive: The builder/estate's listings appear on ibuildnew.com.au search/compare pages with enquiry forms
unknowns: Whether any free/basic listing tier exists behind the demo request
Whether a SaaS tool for builders could partner differently (e.g. integration)
